1) 在采集机上手工 dig @\u003cDNS服务器\u003e \u003: 1) Reproduce it on the collector host with dig @<DNS server> <domain> and check the status and elapsed time; 2) Compare against a public resolver (e.g. dig @223.5.5.5) to tell a DNS server problem from a problem with the domain itself; 3) For a self-hosted resolver, check the service process, upstream forwarding config and network connectivity; 4) Verify the probe's domain, record type and timeout settings are sensible so the config itself is not causing the alert.
DNS 查询出现异常错误，解析链路存在问题。: The DNS query returned an error: there is a problem in the resolution path.
DNS 查询耗时超过 5 秒。解析慢会让每一次新建连接都被拖慢，表现为接口偶发超: DNS query time exceeds 5 seconds. Slow resolution drags down every new connection and shows up as intermittent API timeouts that are hard to trace.
DNS 查询超时，解析请求没有在超时时间内得到响应，依赖该域名的调用会大面积失败: The DNS query timed out: no response arrived within the timeout, and calls depending on that domain will fail broadly.
DNS 查询返回了非 NOERROR 的状态码（如 NXDOMAIN、SERVF: The DNS query returned a non-NOERROR status (such as NXDOMAIN or SERVFAIL): resolution failed and every call depending on that domain will fail.
DNS查询响应时间大于5秒: DNS query response time exceeds 5 seconds
